Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Volker Schlöndorff’s nationality as “German-French” by conflating the film’s Franco-German co-production with the director’s nationality. Schlöndorff is a German director. Even if dual nationality were considered, both directors are from Germany, so the correct conclusion should have been “Yes.” The Planner applied an incorrect “set equality” logic and produced the wrong final answer.
